name: Textile Auxiliaries
description: Auxiliaries in textile chemical processing; surfactants, emulsifiers, wetting agents, dispersing agents, sequestering agents, enzymes, fluorescent brightening agents; sizing agents, thickeners, binders, foaming and de-foaming agents; oxidizing and reducing agents, buffers, electrolytes, discharging agents, stain removing agents, dye fixing agents and leveling agents; regulatory standards (REACH, GOTS, OEKO-TEX), environmental assessment, green processing by plasma, microwave and supercritical fluids; application by padding, spraying, exhaustion, foam and coating; performance testing of auxiliaries; process optimization.
